subject: Document VALKEYCLI_HOST/PORT variables in help (#3520)
reason: The change only edits the static usage/help text printed by valkey-cli (documenting the pre-existing VALKEYCLI_HOST/VALKEYCLI_PORT environment variables for -h and -p). No code path that parses options, reads the environment variables, connects, or executes commands is modified, so there is no behaviour to break: no crash, data, replication, or reply path is reachable. A help-string wording change needs no fuzzer scenario.
